🇨🇳 中文说明"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## ⚡ Overview & Features"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"`dsh-lanmode` brings seamless and secure local network (LAN) and WAN remote access to DeepSeek Harne"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"h-lanmode` brings seamless and secure local network (LAN) and WAN remote access to DeepSeek Harness:"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"1. **📱 Quick QR Popover**: Tap the smartphone icon in the sidebar footer (`Quick QR` in `sidebar.foo"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"ter` / `sidebar.rail`) to open an interactive SVG QR code. Supports the `/mobileqr` chat tool and AS"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"CII QR output.
2. **📲 PWA & Standalone Mode**: Serves `/dsh-lanmode/manifest.json` with `viewport-fi"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"t=cover` for full-screen mobile experience.
3. **🌐 Automatic mDNS (`dsh.local`)**: Built-in UDP 5353"},{"id":"p7s5","text":" responder announces `dsh.local` across the LAN automatically.
4. **🔐 Local Root CA & HTTPS**: Gener"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"ates a 10-year Root CA and trusted SAN certificates (`dsh.local`, LAN IP, localhost). One-click down"},{"id":"p7s7","text":"load via `/dsh-lanmode/ca.crt`.
5. **🔔 Background Web Push & Notifications API**: Delivers system pu"},{"id":"p7s8","text":"sh notifications on agent turn end and approval requests.
6. **🛡️ Comprehensive Security & Authentic"},{"id":"p7s9","text":"ation**:
- Authentication passwords support plaintext and scrypt key derivation. Verified in constan"},{"id":"p7s10","text":"t time via `timingSafeEqual`.
- LAN PIN protection with plaintext or `PBKDF2` stretching (`pbkdf2$sh"},{"id":"p7s11","text":"a512$100000$salt$hash`). Auto-lockout for 15 minutes after 5 consecutive failures.
- Device and sess"},{"id":"p7s12","text":"ion tokens stored exclusively as salted `SHA-256` digests.
- Subnet role separation (`adminAllow` an"},{"id":"p7s13","text":"d `guestAllow`). Guest subnets cannot mutate settings or revoke sessions.
7. **☁️ Cloudflare WAN Tun"},{"id":"p7s14","text":"nels & Tailscale Funnel**:
- Supports zero-config `Quick Tunnels` (trycloudflare.com) and persistent"},{"id":"p7s15","text":" `Named Tunnels` via token (passed securely via `TUNNEL_TOKEN` env, hidden from `ps aux`).
- The `tu"},{"id":"p7s16","text":"nnelPin` option enforces LAN PIN verification for all requests arriving over WAN tunnels.
- 1-click "},{"id":"p7s17","text":"`Tailscale Funnel` integration providing public HTTPS with automated trusted Let's Encrypt certifica"},{"id":"p7s18","text":"tes.
8. **📱 Device Registry & Session Revocation**: Track connected devices and revoke active sessio"},{"id":"p7s19","text":"ns individually or all-at-once."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## 📦 Installation"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## ⚙️ Configuration (`cordis.patch.yml`)"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## 📄 License"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"MIT © GooDAnDReaDY"}],"truncated":false}
